item.title: The Bitter Lesson
item.description: Looking back over decades of AI research, the piece argues that general methods which scale with computation, namely search and learning, have always eventually beaten approaches that build in human knowledge, and that researchers should build meta-methods that discover rather than encode what we think we know. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). Outro: “Crap Transition” by Jesse Spillane, https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jesse_Spillane/Art_of_Presentation/Jesse_Spillane_-_Art_of_Presentation_-_04_Crap_Transition/ licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed, faded and mixed with narration.
